### Architecture and Mechanics

The solver in [solution.cpp](file:///workspace/benchmarks/ahc004/solution.cpp) coordinates six algorithmic phases:

1. Maximal Read Filtering: Identifies duplicate strings and removes strict subsegments that are contained inside longer reads.
2. Fast Toroidal Prefix Trie: Constructs an 8-ary trie over all target strings to update and scan matches across all 800 cyclic starting points in O(1) time per single-cell mutation.
3. Multi-Restart Greedy Superstring Assembly: Runs 50 randomized restarts of greedy overlap merges across both horizontal and vertical orientations to pack maximal reads into 20 toroidal lines.
4. 4-Way Torus Invariant Simulated Annealing: Applies 25,000 iterations of cyclic row shifts, row permutations, col shifts, and col permutations. Row shifts leave horizontal substrings intact while creating vertical intersection matches.
5. Progressive 2D Non-Destructive Placement: Injects remaining unplaced reads into low-conflict 2D grid positions whenever net match score strictly improves.
6. Local Quenching and Coordinate Descent: Fills remaining blank cells and quenches all 400 cells to local optimality.
7. Multi-Candidate Large Neighborhood Search: Continuously samples unplaced reads, finds top partial matching alignments, injects full strings, repairs the modified cells with coordinate descent, and keeps improvements or reverts via an exact undo stack.

The best known source code remains in [benchmarks/ahc004/solution.cpp](file:///workspace/benchmarks/ahc004/solution.cpp).
